rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sequential deck read, raw lines 1-59. Chunk 0 (1-20) establishes 'the context window' (17) and title noun 'the window' (1). Chunk 1 (21-30) line25 blockquote 'It can also stop short, and that one is harder to catch' — 'It'/'that one' resolve to the immediately preceding clause 'Claude starts reading dozens of files', in-chunk. Chunk 3 (40-44) line42 'The account is a reconstruction' and line43 'spot-check it' resolve via the chunk's own header (line40 'the self-report'). Chunk 4 (45-54) line47 'how full it is' and line49 'the window'/'fills it' resolve via chunk-0's established 'the context window' plus this chunk's own line47 'The context window has a ceiling'; line53 'the same thing' resolves to the immediately preceding sentence in the same chunk (line47-49, what /context shows). Chunk 5 (55-59) line58 'The window holds only so much... you choose what fills it' resolves via chunk-0 + chunk-4 established 'context window'/'window' and the chunk's own header noun. 'Your repo'/'it' throughout (23, 27) resolve via the session-artifact carve-out (student's own repo, chosen in prework; maintainer 'Plug points'). No never-named, vague-with-history, or re-chunk-stranded referent found across chunks 1-5.

No body chunk points at another file or slide by position. External resources named directly by title in running prose ('ccstatusline', '/statusline', line53), not located by position. Arc callbacks ('Connections', 'the-wizard-move lecture') live only in the maintainer block (below the cut, line60+), never in a student-facing chunk.

All six chunks (lines1-59) carry a self-carrying claim or instruction. Chunk 3 (40-44) is the thinnest — no prompt block, by design — but states the confabulation heuristic and the spot-check instruction independently of any other slide. No chunk reduces to a bare wait-state or a single context-dependent fragment.

Each heading (lines21, 31, 40, 45, 55) accurately previews its own chunk under the sequential read: line40 'Read the self-report, then spot-check it' previews exactly the chunk's two bullets (unreliability at 42, spot-check instruction at 43); line45 'Check how full the window is' previews the /context bullet and prompt that follow; line55 'The slice Claude didn't load' previews the two bullets naming the unloaded slice and its consequence. No header is contradicted by its own chunk.

Checked all six sub-items against lines1-58: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative; no abstraction-noun stack; no verb triplet with an empty leg. The one number-plus-retraction instance ('Assume about 10% of what it says or does is made up. Could be more or less than this heuristic suggests.', line42, chunk3) is explicitly cleared by a maintainer accept-note at line82 ('Deliberate phrasing (maintainer-attested, do not edit)... check_slides.md rule 7's number-plus-retraction sub-item does NOT fire here') — accept-with-note, no edit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Four headings (lines21, 31, 40, 45) are plain imperatives/phase-style, correct for an exercise. The closer 'The slice Claude didn't load' (line55) is a noun phrase naming its subject (gapped relative clause), not a subject+predicate assertion like the compendium's two counted exercise declaratives ('Anything can be reverse-engineered', 'There is always a next plausible answer') — it reads under the catalogue-entry-naming-subject carve-out ('The numbers', 'Verification, named'). The rule's binding test — 'the header IS the teaching' with 'a label [that] would waste the beat' — does not fire here because the generalizing claim is carried in the chunk's own bullets (lines57-58: 'the least context that holds exactly what the task needs' / 'stays real... you choose what fills it'), not left for the header alone to state.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Checked every body bullet (lines23, 33-34, 42-43, 47, 57-58) against the three classes. None restates a doctrine/law already announced earlier in this body — each states its content for the first time (the '10%' heuristic and 'context window is not your codebase' each appear exactly once). None is self-referential design commentary about the curriculum's own pedagogy — every bullet describes the student's practice on their own repo. The bullet closest to an aphorism kicker is line58 ('The slice Claude didn't load stays real. The window holds only so much; going forward, you choose what fills it.'), whose opening clause echoes the chunk's own header (line55) — but it earns its slot: it adds that the unread content remains consequential ('stays real') plus a forward agency instruction ('you choose what fills it'), neither of which the bare header states. Stays inside the rule.
